fuse_conv_bn_qat: fuse conv and batch norm layers in a QAT-annotated GraphModule using subgraph rewriting
fold_conv_bn_qat: fold batch norm weights into conv weights in a quantized QAT GraphModule with q-dq nodes
duplicate_dequantize_node: duplicate dequantize nodes in a GraphModule so each user gets its own dequantize instance
remove_extra_dequantize: merge duplicate dequantize nodes in a GraphModule into a single shared dequantize node
get_conv_bn_pattern: build a callable pattern representing a conv followed by batch norm for subgraph matching
